# CTV News
> Canadian news publisher covering breaking local, national, and international news with video, live streams, and regional editions.

CTV News provides ongoing reporting across Canada and worldwide, with dedicated sections for politics, business, health, entertainment, sports, weather, opinion, photo galleries, and city-based local news sites.

## Main News Sections
- [Home](https://www.ctvnews.ca/): Main news homepage with top stories, breaking coverage, and featured video.
- [Canada](https://www.ctvnews.ca/canada): National news coverage from across Canada.
- [World](https://www.ctvnews.ca/world): International news, global affairs, and major world events.
- [Politics](https://www.ctvnews.ca/politics): Federal politics, elections, Parliament, and policy reporting.
- [Business](https://www.ctvnews.ca/business): Canadian and global business, markets, personal finance, and economy news.
- [Health](https://www.ctvnews.ca/health): Health reporting, medical research, public health, and wellness news.
- [Sci-Tech](https://www.ctvnews.ca/sci-tech): Science, technology, space, and innovation coverage.
- [Entertainment](https://www.ctvnews.ca/entertainment): Celebrity, film, television, music, and culture news.

## Video and Live Coverage
- [Video](https://www.ctvnews.ca/video): News clips, interviews, explainers, and featured video reports.
- [CTV News Now](https://www.ctvnews.ca/now/): Live and on-demand CTV News streaming coverage.
- [Live Special Coverage](https://www.ctvnews.ca/video?playlistId=1.2966224): Special live event and breaking news video coverage.
- [Top Video](https://www.ctvnews.ca/video?clipId=68597): Featured and trending news videos.
- [W5](https://www.ctvnews.ca/w5/): Long-form investigative journalism and documentary reporting.
- [Question Period](https://www.ctvnews.ca/question-period): Political affairs program with interviews and analysis.
- [Power Play](https://www.ctvnews.ca/politics/power-play): Daily political news program covering federal politics.

## Topics and Ongoing Coverage
- [Trump's Tariffs](https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/trumps-tariffs): Ongoing coverage of tariffs, trade policy, and related global impacts.
- [Climate and Environment](https://www.ctvnews.ca/climate-and-environment): Reporting on climate change, weather impacts, and environmental policy.
- [Consumer](https://www.ctvnews.ca/consumer): Consumer issues, recalls, scams, and household cost stories.
- [Autos](https://www.ctvnews.ca/autos): Automotive industry news, vehicle trends, and transportation coverage.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.ctvnews.ca/lifestyle): Lifestyle reporting on food, travel, relationships, and everyday living.
- [Opinion](https://www.ctvnews.ca/opinion): Commentary and analysis from columnists and contributors.
- [In Pictures](https://www.ctvnews.ca/photos/): Photo galleries covering news events, features, and notable moments.
- [Shopping Trends](https://www.ctvnews.ca/shopping-trends/): Product trend coverage, seasonal shopping guides, and consumer-focused features.

## Programs and Shows
- [CTV Your Morning](https://www.ctvnews.ca/ctv-your-morning): Morning show stories, interviews, and lifestyle segments.
- [W5](https://www.ctvnews.ca/w5/): Investigative program archive with episodes and feature reports.
- [Question Period](https://www.ctvnews.ca/question-period): Weekly political interview program and related coverage.
- [Power Play](https://www.ctvnews.ca/politics/power-play): Political program clips, interviews, and daily analysis.
- [CTV National News](https://www.ctvnews.ca/video?playlistId=1.2965514): National newscast video clips and segments.
- [CTV News Channel](https://www.ctvnews.ca/video?playlistId=1.2966224): Continuous news channel highlights and live coverage.
